AboutCompany.companyShort: Government-approved manpower recruitment company providing reliable workforce solutions across Saudi Arabia.
AboutCompany.description: Founded with a clear vision to become Saudi Arabia’s most trusted manpower provider, Future Focus Company has grown into a premier workforce partner. We empower key sectors—including construction and facility management—by delivering skilled, compliant, and efficient talent. Driven by a commitment to excellence, we are dedicated to supporting the Kingdom's rapidly growing business needs through reliable, long-term partnerships.

AboutIntro.description: Future Focus Company connects employers in Saudi Arabia with qualified workforce sourced from over 10 countries across Asia. Through our trusted international recruitment network, we provide complete HR and workforce solutions for construction, hospitality, industrial, logistics, healthcare, and other major sectors throughout the Kingdom.
AboutIntro.subtitle: Skilled, semi-skilled & unskilled workers — vetted, documented, and deployed on time.

AboutPage.ceoMessage: At Future Focus Company, our vision is to be the foremost provider of skilled manpower in Saudi Arabia, supporting the nation’s journey towards economic diversification and sustainable development. As CEO, I assure our clients and partners of our unwavering commitment to quality, safety, and innovation. We strive to exceed expectations through tailored solutions, rapid deployment, and a customer-centric approach. We look forward to collaborating with you and contributing to your success in the facilities management industry.

AboutPage.mdMessage: Welcome to Future Focus Company. As the GM, I am committed to delivering exceptional manpower solutions that drive the success of our clients in Saudi Arabia’s facilities management sector. Our dedicated team ensures reliability, quality, and compliance in every workforce we provide. We are passionate about building long-term partnerships based on trust, integrity, and excellence. Together, we aim to contribute to the sustainable growth and development of the Kingdom. Thank you for choosing us as your trusted manpower partner.

items.question: How quickly do you respond to enquiries?
items.answer: Our team usually responds within 2–3 business hours during Saudi office hours. WhatsApp inquiries receive the fastest response.

items.question: How long does it take to deploy workers?
items.answer: Deployment generally takes 15–30 days depending on visa approval, documentation, and the required profession.

items.question: What information should I include in my enquiry?
items.answer: Please mention the job category, number of workers required, project location, expected joining date, and your contact information.

items.question: Can I visit your Riyadh office?
items.answer: Yes. We welcome employers to visit our Riyadh office by appointment during business hours.

items.question: Is there a minimum order for manpower supply?
items.answer: No. We can provide a single worker or hundreds of workers depending on your business requirements.

items.question: Which industries do you supply workers for?
items.answer: We provide manpower for construction, hospitality, cleaning, logistics, security, healthcare, factories, supermarkets, offices, restaurants and many more.

PrivacyPolicy.privacySubtitle: How Future Focus Company protects and safeguards the personal and corporate information of candidates and employers.
PrivacyPolicy.sec1Desc: Welcome to Future Focus Company. We are committed to protecting the privacy and security of the personal and corporate information shared with us by job seekers (candidates) and employers (clients). This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website or use our recruitment services.
PrivacyPolicy.sec2AutoDesc: IP address, browser type, device information, and website usage data collected via cookies to enhance user experience and site functionality.
PrivacyPolicy.sec2CandidatesDesc: Full name, contact details, email address, date of birth, passport details, educational qualifications, employment history (CV/Resume), trade test results, and medical clearance reports (e.g., GAMCA).
PrivacyPolicy.sec2EmployersDesc: Company name, commercial registration details, contact person information, email, phone numbers, workforce requirements, and visa quota details.
PrivacyPolicy.sec3Item1: To match candidates with suitable job opportunities in Saudi Arabia and the GCC.
PrivacyPolicy.sec3Item2: To process visa applications, medical clearances, and travel documentation.
PrivacyPolicy.sec3Item3: To provide employers with candidate profiles for screening and selection.
PrivacyPolicy.sec3Item4: To communicate regarding job alerts, interview schedules, and manpower deployment updates.
PrivacyPolicy.sec3Item5: To comply with local and international labor laws, including MHRSD (Saudi Arabia) and BMET (Bangladesh) regulations.
PrivacyPolicy.sec4Desc: We do not sell your personal data. We may share your information only with:
PrivacyPolicy.sec4Item1Desc: Candidate CVs and trade test results are shared with verified clients for hiring purposes.
PrivacyPolicy.sec4Item2Desc: Embassies, immigration departments, and ministries (e.g., MHRSD) for visa and legal processing.
PrivacyPolicy.sec4Item3Desc: Medical testing centers (GAMCA), flight booking agencies, and training institutes directly involved in your deployment process.
PrivacyPolicy.sec5Desc: We implement strict technical and organizational security measures to protect your data from unauthorized access. We retain candidate and client data only for as long as necessary to fulfill our recruitment services or to comply with legal obligations.
PrivacyPolicy.sec6Desc: Candidates and employers have the right to request access to, correction, or deletion of their personal/corporate data held by us. To exercise these rights, please contact us at operations@ffccom.net or +966 56 616 7562.

Process.description: From the first enquiry to the final deployment, every step is carefully managed by our experienced recruitment team to ensure a smooth hiring experience for employers across Saudi Arabia.

steps.title: Enquiry
steps.description: We understand your workforce requirements, project scope, job roles, quantity, qualifications, and deployment schedule.

steps.title: Strategy
steps.description: Our recruitment specialists prepare a customized hiring strategy and timeline tailored to your business needs.

steps.title: Sourcing
steps.description: Qualified candidates are sourced, interviewed, trade-tested, medically examined, and carefully shortlisted.

steps.title: Clearance
steps.description: Government approvals, employer verification, medical clearance, and recruitment compliance are completed.

steps.title: Documentation
steps.description: Employment contracts, visas, passports, insurance, and all required legal documentation are processed.

steps.title: Deployment
steps.description: Workers travel to Saudi Arabia and are deployed safely to the employer with complete post-arrival support.

TermsOfService.sec3Item1Desc: You confirm that all information provided (CV, experience, passport, educational certificates) is true, accurate, and valid. Submission of fraudulent documents will result in immediate disqualification and potential legal action.
TermsOfService.sec3Item2Desc: Submitting an application does not guarantee job placement or visa approval. Final selection is at the sole discretion of the employer, and visa issuance is determined by the respective embassy.
TermsOfService.sec3Item3Desc: Future Focus Company operates strictly within government-approved fee structures. We do not charge unauthorized upfront recruitment fees. Candidates are strictly advised not to pay any money to third-party brokers or unofficial sub-agents claiming to represent us.

item1.name: Ahmed Al-Zahrani
item1.quote: Future Focus Company provided us with 150 skilled scaffolders and masons for our NEOM project. Their strict trade-testing process ensured we got exactly the quality we needed. Highly recommended.

item10.name: Aisha Al-Farsi
item10.quote: Future Focus understands the GCC labor laws perfectly. Their candidate onboarding and documentation process is the best we've seen from South Asia.

item11.name: Rahim Uddin
item11.quote: Future Focus Company is 100% genuine. They didn't ask for any hidden fees, and my visa processing was transparent. Now I am working in a reputed company in Riyadh.

item12.name: Nusrat Jahan
item12.quote: I was guided perfectly for my medical and embassy interviews. The team is very supportive, and they ensured my safe travel to Dubai. Thank you, Future Focus!

item13.name: Abdul Karim
item13.quote: Their process is very fast. I applied, gave my trade test, and within two months I was flying. The salary and benefits promised match exactly with my contract.

item14.quote: Many agencies make fake promises, but Future Focus is different. They explained everything clearly and placed me in a 5-star hotel in Jeddah.

item15.name: Mehedi Hasan
item15.quote: From my initial interview to my final flight, the Future Focus team was always available to answer my questions. A highly professional agency for Bangladeshi workers.

item2.name: Fatima Al-Sayed
item2.quote: We struggled with sourcing qualified nurses until we partnered with Future Focus. Their team handled the Prometric and Dataflow processes seamlessly. A truly reliable manpower partner.

item3.name: Khalid Mansour
item3.quote: The hospitality staff deployed by Future Focus were well-trained, English-speaking, and ready to work. Their 90-day replacement guarantee gave us great peace of mind.

item4.name: Omar Tariq
item4.quote: What impressed me most was their turnaround time. We needed 50 certified electricians urgently, and Future Focus managed the sourcing, visa, and deployment within 45 days.

item5.name: Saeed Al-Maktoum
item5.quote: Sourcing heavy vehicle drivers with valid GCC licenses was a challenge. Future Focus not only found the right candidates but also ensured all their medical and legal clearances were flawless.

item6.name: Yasser Al-Qahtani
item6.quote: Professional, transparent, and strictly compliant with MHRSD guidelines. They are our go-to agency for hiring both skilled and semi-skilled cleaning personnel.

item7.name: Hassan Al-Nasser
item7.quote: We hired a team of 10 network engineers through them. The candidates were technically sound and culturally adaptable. Future Focus made international hiring effortless.

item8.name: Tariq Bin Ziyad
item8.quote: Their 5-step turnkey deployment workflow is incredibly efficient. We received regular updates on candidate medicals and visa stamping without having to ask.

item9.name: Faisal Al-Dosari
item9.quote: Excellent support from their Dhaka office. They arranged live video interviews and practical trade tests for our team to evaluate the crane operators directly.
